payload.explanation: The diagnostic report attributes the stuck inventory decrement to lock contention: the business session_21fde0d1aa9b is blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_fc8c2dded3dd, an abandoned idle-in-transaction session that already applied the same UPDATE uncommitted. The state report confirms session_fc8c2dded3dd is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock, discards its duplicate decrement, and lets the business request complete to stock=99, preserving unrelated transactions.
